types.description: Provisional generic normally open momentary pushbutton; no selected hardware or ratings.

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: Single momentary NO pair 13/14; both ends are required for the sole contact circuit. Optional: none in this interface. Unmodeled: illumination, extra contacts and bonding of actual buttons. Select hardware and add applicable ratings; markings are a generic convention, not a manufacturer pinout.
